preview: Football's back, and the Hogs open the Ryan Silverfield era against a North Alabama team the Razorbacks have somehow never played before. Vegas has Arkansas favored by about 40.....

Credit where it's due: North Alabama is the only school in America with a live lion living on campus, they won three straight Division II national titles back in the '90s, and this fall they finally moved into a brand-new stadium in Florence after 76 years in the old one. Respect. That said — they went 2-10 last year, they're breaking in new coordinators on both sides, and Silverfield already knows their defensive line by heart from his Memphis days.

Fun side plot: Bobby Petrino is calling plays at North Carolina now, dropped his opener, and got flagged 11 times — tape Silverfield reportedly showed the team as a "do NOT do this" reel. Hog fans will resist the urge to make a motorcycle joke. Mostly.
Kickoff 3:15, SEC Network. Menu's Shilo's Tacos. Bring cash, bring an appetite, and let's start 1-0.
